crossRefs.note: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, “What they are building, if a fox climbed up it, he would break down…
How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?
therefore this iniquity shall be to you like a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking comes…

translations.web: Thus I will accomplish my wrath on the wall, and on those who have plastered it with whitewash. I will tell you, ‘The wall is no more, neither those who plastered it;
translations.bsb: And after I have vented My wrath against the wall and against those who whitewashed it, I will say to you: ‘The wall is gone, and so are those who whitewashed it—
translations.kjv: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that have daubed it with untempered morter, and will say unto you, The wall is no more, neither they that daubed
translations.asv: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that have daubed it with untempered mortar; and I will say unto you, The wall is no more, neither they that daubed it;
